about: The ancient images to collect, one per myth, each named after its myth. A source is either a Wikimedia Commons file ("file"), a Commons search ("commons": the best freely licensed match), a Met object ("met": its object id, kept only if the Met marks it public domain) or a Met search ("metSearch"). Run python3 tools/myths/fetch_myth_images.py --list to see the candidates, pin the right one, then --fetch.
